sentences.text: The name Apatosagittarius means "false secretarybird" because it looked similar to the modern secretary bird.
This extinct genus of hawks, belonging to the family Accipitridae, was found in Nebraska.
The genus was described by Feduccia and Voorhies in 1989.
Scientists have records of two fossil occurrences of this species.
Apatosagittarius lived between 12.5 and 9.4 million years ago during the Late Miocene epoch.
